CHECK (jsonb_typeof(dns) = 'object'::text AND dns ? 'state'::text AND (dns - ARRAY['state'::text, 'addresses'::text, 'failure_code'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND ((dns ->> 'state'::text) = 'observed'::text AND NOT dns ? 'failure_code'::text AND jsonb_typeof(dns -> 'addresses'::text) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(dns -> 'addresses'::text) >= 1 AND jsonb_array_length(dns -> 'addresses'::text) <= 8 OR (dns ->> 'state'::text) = 'failed'::text AND NOT dns ? 'addresses'::text AND ((dns ->> 'failure_code'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['dns_no_answer'::text, 'dns_timeout'::text, 'dns_lookup_failed'::text]))))

CHECK (jsonb_typeof(https) = 'object'::text AND https ? 'state'::text AND (https - ARRAY['state'::text, 'http_status'::text, 'response_sample_sha256'::text, 'response_sample_bytes'::text, 'response_truncated'::text, 'failure_code'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND ((https ->> 'state'::text) = 'not_attempted'::text AND NOT https ? 'http_status'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_sample_sha256'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_sample_bytes'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_truncated'::text AND NOT https ? 'failure_code'::text OR (https ->> 'state'::text) = 'observed'::text AND jsonb_typeof(https -> 'http_status'::text) = 'number'::text AND ((https ->> 'http_status'::text)::integer) >= 100 AND ((https ->> 'http_status'::text)::integer) <= 599 AND (https ->> 'response_sample_sha256'::text) ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND https ? 'response_sample_bytes'::text AND jsonb_typeof(https -> 'response_sample_bytes'::text) = 'number'::text AND ((https ->> 'response_sample_bytes'::text)::integer) >= 0 AND ((https ->> 'response_sample_bytes'::text)::integer) <= 65536 AND https ? 'response_truncated'::text AND jsonb_typeof(https -> 'response_truncated'::text) = 'boolean'::text AND NOT https ? 'failure_code'::text OR (https ->> 'state'::text) = 'failed'::text AND NOT https ? 'http_status'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_sample_sha256'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_sample_bytes'::text AND NOT https ? 'response_truncated'::text AND ((https ->> 'failure_code'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['https_timeout'::text, 'https_transport_failed'::text]))))

CHECK (report_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$'::text AND report_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM owner_admin_id)) > 0 AND hostname = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM hostname)) AND length(hostname) >= 1 AND length(hostname) <= 253)

CHECK (((dns ->> 'state'::text) <> 'failed'::text OR (tls ->> 'state'::text) = 'not_attempted'::text AND (https ->> 'state'::text) = 'not_attempted'::text) AND (((tls ->> 'state'::text) <> ALL (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'not_attempted'::text])) OR (https ->> 'state'::text) = 'not_attempted'::text))
FOREIGN KEY (owner_admin_id) REFERENCES admin_credentials(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (jsonb_typeof(tls) = 'object'::text AND tls ? 'state'::text AND (tls - ARRAY['state'::text, 'certificate_sha256'::text, 'failure_code'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND ((tls ->> 'state'::text) = 'not_attempted'::text AND NOT tls ? 'certificate_sha256'::text AND NOT tls ? 'failure_code'::text OR (tls ->> 'state'::text) = 'observed'::text AND (tls ->> 'certificate_sha256'::text) ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND NOT tls ? 'failure_code'::text OR (tls ->> 'state'::text) = 'failed'::text AND NOT tls ? 'certificate_sha256'::text AND ((tls ->> 'failure_code'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['tls_connect_failed'::text, 'tls_name_mismatch'::text, 'tls_certificate_invalid'::text, 'tls_timeout'::text]))))

ARRAY['task_id'::text, 'image'::text, 'runtime_state'::text, 'probe_outcome'::text, 'http_status'::text, 'cleanup_confirmed'::text, 'evidence_digest'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM runtime_evidence ->> 'task_id'::text)) > 0 AND jsonb_typeof(runtime_evidence -> 'image'::text) = 'object'::text AND ((runtime_evidence -> 'image'::text) - ARRAY['repository'::text, 'digest'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND ((runtime_evidence -> 'image'::text) ->> 'repository'::text) = validated_image_repository AND ((runtime_evidence -> 'image'::text) ->> 'digest'::text) = validated_image_digest AND (runtime_evidence ->> 'runtime_state'::text) = 'stopped'::text AND (runtime_evidence ->> 'probe_outcome'::text) = 'responded'::text AND (runtime_evidence -> 'cleanup_confirmed'::text) = 'true'::jsonb AND (runtime_evidence ->> 'evidence_digest'::text) ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND expires_at > created_at)

CHECK (state = 'source_matched'::text AND matched_source_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND matched_commit ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$'::text OR state <> 'source_matched'::text AND matched_source_revision_id IS NULL AND matched_commit IS NULL)

relations.view_definition:
SELECT application_id,
    environment_id,
    deployment_id,
    release_id,
    service_name,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    revision,
    source_digest,
    sample_count,
    cpu_seconds,
    memory_byte_seconds,
    disk_byte_seconds,
    runtime_seconds,
    average_cpu_millicores,
    average_memory_bytes,
    average_disk_bytes,
    trend_cpu_millicores_per_second,
    trend_memory_bytes_per_second,
    trend_disk_bytes_per_second,
    network_rx_bytes,
    network_tx_bytes,
    restart_count,
    exception_count,
    peak_cpu_millicores,
    peak_memory_bytes,
    peak_disk_bytes,
    limit_cpu_millicores,
    limit_memory_bytes,
    limit_disk_bytes,
    limit_pids,
    created_at,
    current_rank
   FROM ( SELECT b.application_id,
            b.environment_id,
            b.deployment_id,
            b.release_id,
            b.service_name,
            b.window_start,
            b.window_end,
            b.revision,
            b.source_digest,
            b.sample_count,
            b.cpu_seconds,
            b.memory_byte_seconds,
            b.disk_byte_seconds,
            b.runtime_seconds,
            b.average_cpu_millicores,
            b.average_memory_bytes,
            b.average_disk_bytes,
            b.trend_cpu_millicores_per_second,
            b.trend_memory_bytes_per_second,
            b.trend_disk_bytes_per_second,
            b.network_rx_bytes,
            b.network_tx_bytes,
            b.restart_count,
            b.exception_count,
            b.peak_cpu_millicores,
            b.peak_memory_bytes,
            b.peak_disk_bytes,
            b.limit_cpu_millicores,
            b.limit_memory_bytes,
            b.limit_disk_bytes,
            b.limit_pids,
            b.created_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.application_id, b.environment_id, b.deployment_id, b.release_id, b.service_name, b.window_start ORDER BY b.revision DESC) AS current_rank
           FROM m5_usage_bucket_facts b) ranked
  WHERE current_rank = 1;

relations.name: m6_ai_intervention_metrics
relations.view_definition:
SELECT count(*) AS interventions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.status, ''::text), NULLIF(i.outcome, ''::text), i.status) = 'succeeded'::text) AS succeeded,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.status, ''::text), NULLIF(i.outcome, ''::text), i.status) = 'failed'::text) AS failed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(o.status, ''::text), NULLIF(i.outcome, ''::text), i.status) = 'rolled_back'::text) AS rolled_back,
    COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(o.tokens, i.tokens)), 0::numeric) AS tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(o.duration_ms, i.duration_ms)), 0::numeric) AS duration_ms,
    count(DISTINCT cr.candidate_id) AS distinct_candidates
   FROM m6_ai_invocations i
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m6_ai_outcomes.status,
            m6_ai_outcomes.tokens,
            m6_ai_outcomes.duration_ms
           FROM m6_ai_outcomes
          WHERE m6_ai_outcomes.invocation_id = i.id
          ORDER BY m6_ai_outcomes.created_at DESC, m6_ai_outcomes.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) o ON true
     LEFT JOIN m6_ai_candidate_refs cr ON cr.invocation_id = i.id;

relations.name: m6_ai_settings_current
relations.view_definition:
SELECT id,
    idempotency_key,
    request_digest,
    version,
    enabled,
    profile,
    provider,
    model,
    data_scopes,
    max_tokens,
    max_duration_ms,
    cooldown_ms,
    cache_enabled,
    actor,
    external_calls,
    payload,
    created_at
   FROM m6_ai_settings_events
  ORDER BY version DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC
 LIMIT 1;
